meta.note: Each programme page was opened on 29 October 2026. Dates and money change, so always check the official page before you apply.

programs.name: BlueDot Impact courses
programs.what: Online courses from a two hour introduction to multi week courses and project sprints on AI safety, AGI strategy and AI governance.

programs.name: ARENA
programs.what: The Alignment Research Engineer Accelerator gives people the skills, community and confidence to work directly on technical AI safety. ARENA 9.0 ran from 5 October to 6 November 2026 at LISA in London.
programs.cost: Travel, visa, accommodation and meals covered for participants. Its curriculum materials are open for self study.

programs.name: SPAR
programs.what: A part time, remote research programme that pairs aspiring researchers with professionals. 5 to 40 hours a week for three months, ending in a Demo Day. Over 250 mentors in Fall 2026.

programs.name: MATS
programs.what: An independent research fellowship that connects researchers with top mentors in alignment, transparency and security. 12 weeks in Berkeley or London, with a chance to apply for a 6 to 12 month funded extension.

programs.name: LASR Labs
programs.what: Teams of three or four, supervised by an experienced researcher, take a project on loss of control risks from proposal to publication over 13 weeks at LISA.
programs.next: Next cohort runs June to September 2027.

programs.name: Anthropic Fellows Program
programs.what: Four months of full time empirical safety or security research with direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers, aiming for a public output such as a paper. More than 200 fellows since early 2025.
programs.cost: Weekly stipend of 3,850 USD, 2,310 GBP or 4,300 CAD, plus about 15,000 USD a month for compute

programs.name: ERA Fellowship (Cambridge)
programs.what: Research on understanding and reducing risks from frontier AI. 200+ alumni now work at places like the UK AI Security Institute, the European AI Office, GovAI and METR.
programs.next: The Winter 2027 fellowship runs 18 January to 26 March; applications are closed.

programs.name: Astra Fellowship (Constellation)
programs.what: A fully funded, in person programme that pairs senior advisors with emerging talent on five month technical, governance, strategy and field building projects.

programs.name: GovAI fellowships
programs.what: Three month Summer or Winter Fellowships in the UK on a Research or Applied track, a DC Fellowship, and longer Research Scholar roles in AI governance. They accept applicants from anywhere.

programs.name: IAPS AI Policy Fellowship
programs.what: A fully funded three month programme to build practical AI policy skills. The Spring 2027 round runs 22 February to 14 May 2027.
programs.cost: Stipend of 18,000 USD for Fellows and 24,000 USD for Senior Fellows

programs.name: Pivotal Research AI Safety Fellowship
programs.what: Fifteen weeks in London doing AI safety research with expert mentors.

programs.name: AI Safety Camp
programs.what: Online team research projects. People with an idea can lead a project and others join their team. The 2027 edition is virtual.

programs.name: Apart Research sprints
programs.what: Weekend research hackathons on one AI safety question, open to anyone. Strong entries can lead to the Apart Fellowship.

programs.name: Horizon Career Accelerator
programs.what: A part time, remote programme with mentorship, training and coaching to launch a career in AI policy, mainly in the US.

programs.name: UK AI Security Institute careers
programs.what: Researchers, engineers, policy analysts and operators working on frontier AI inside the UK government.

programs.name: 80,000 Hours
programs.what: Free career reviews of AI safety research, AI governance and more, a job board with roles picked for impact, and one to one advice.

programs.name: AISafety.com
programs.what: Curated lists of training programmes, events, communities, self study material, jobs and funding, maintained by community builders.

paths.d: Make AI systems safer directly: interpretability, evals, control, alignment training. Needs coding and some maths.
steps: Do the ARENA materials or Neel Nanda's mech interp guide on your own
Reproduce one small paper from the Papers page
Apply to SPAR or an Apart sprint
Then MATS, LASR or the Anthropic Fellows Program

paths.d: Shape the rules: laws, standards, international deals and lab policies. Needs clear writing and patience.
steps: Read the Policy tracker and pick one law to know well
Apply to GovAI, IAPS or a Horizon programme

paths.d: Build the infrastructure safety teams need: eval harnesses, monitors, sandboxes, datasets.
steps: Ship a small open source eval or monitor
Join a hackathon and finish something
Contribute to an open safety repo
Look at engineering roles on the 80,000 Hours job board

paths.d: Explain the risks clearly, run groups, write, make videos, organise events in your city or college.
steps: Start a reading group with the Start here papers
Run a local meetup or an Apart sprint site
Look at BlueDot and Astra for field building work

quiz.q: How much time can you give right now?
o: Full time for a few months
I can travel to the UK or US
Some projects or study behind me
Already doing research or policy work
